sentences.content: Today was our first day to visit Moscow.
sentences.english: Today was our first day to visit Moscow
sentences.chinese: 今天是我们游览莫斯科的第一天。

sentences.content: The weather was fine and everyone felt excited to visit some famous places in Russia.
sentences.english: The weather was fine and everyone felt excited to visit some famous places in Russia
sentences.chinese: 天气晴朗，大家都对游览俄罗斯的一些著名景点感到兴奋。

sentences.content: In the morning, we went to the Victory Museum.
sentences.english: In the morning , we went to the Victory Museum
sentences.chinese: 早上，我们去了Victory Museum。

sentences.content: The Russian people built this museum to remember their fight against the Nazis during World War II.
sentences.english: The Russian people built this museum to remember their fight against the Nazis during World War II
sentences.chinese: 俄罗斯人民建造这座博物馆是为了纪念他们在第二次世界大战期间对抗纳粹的战斗。

sentences.content: As we walked through the halls, the tour guide told us stories about the war.
sentences.english: As we walked through the halls , the tour guide told us stories about the war
sentences.chinese: 当我们穿过走廊时，导游向我们讲述了关于战争的故事。

sentences.content: In one hall, I saw an artwork with thousands of glass “tears” falling down.
sentences.english: In one hall , I saw an artwork with thousands of glass " tears " falling down
sentences.chinese: 在一个展厅里，我看到一件艺术品，上面有成千上万颗玻璃“泪滴”垂落而下。

sentences.content: It reminds us that war is terrible and peace does not come easily.
sentences.english: It reminds us that war is terrible and peace does not come easily
sentences.chinese: 它提醒我们战争是可怕的，和平来之不易。

wordDetails.definition: remind（第三人称单数）: 提醒
do（第三人称单数）: 构成疑问或否定

sentences.content: We should not forget that.
sentences.english: We should not forget that
sentences.chinese: 我们不应忘记这一点。

sentences.content: At noon, we had lunch at a restaurant near the park.
sentences.english: At noon , we had lunch at a restaurant near the park
sentences.chinese: 中午，我们在公园附近的一家餐厅吃了午餐。

sentences.content: I liked the ice cream there, so I ate a lot of it.
sentences.english: I liked the ice cream there , so I ate a lot of it
sentences.chinese: 我很喜欢那里的冰淇淋，所以吃了很多。

sentences.content: But, during dinner, I didn’t feel like eating because I felt sick.
sentences.english: But , during dinner , I didn't feel like eating because I felt sick
sentences.chinese: 但是，晚餐时，我感觉不舒服，所以没什么胃口。

sentences.content: So now, I just want to get a good night’s sleep.
sentences.english: So now , I just want to get a good night's sleep
sentences.chinese: 所以现在，我只想好好睡一觉。

sentences.content: It rained last night, so this morning the air was fresh and cool.
sentences.english: It rained last night , so this morning the air was fresh and cool
sentences.chinese: 昨晚下了雨，所以今早空气清新凉爽。

wordDetails.definition: be（过去式）: 构成过去时

sentences.content: I felt much better today.
sentences.english: I felt much better today
sentences.chinese: 今天我感觉好多了。

sentences.content: We took the Moscow Metro to travel around.
sentences.english: We took the Moscow Metro to travel around
sentences.chinese: 我们乘坐莫斯科地铁出行。

sentences.content: The metro stations are really beautiful.
sentences.english: The metro stations are really beautiful
sentences.chinese: 这些地铁站真是美极了。

sentences.content: Sometimes I felt like I was walking inside a palace.
sentences.english: Sometimes I felt like I was walking inside a palace
sentences.chinese: 有时我感觉自己仿佛行走在宫殿之中。

wordDetails.definition: be（过去式）: 构成过去进行时

sentences.content: After that, we went to Red Square.
sentences.english: After that , we went to Red Square
sentences.chinese: 之后，我们去了红场。

sentences.content: It was fantastic!
sentences.english: It was fantastic !
sentences.chinese: 太棒了！

sentences.content: In the afternoon, we arrived at a school and met a group of Russian students.
sentences.english: In the afternoon , we arrived at a school and met a group of Russian students
sentences.chinese: 下午，我们抵达一所学校，遇到了一群俄罗斯学生。

sentences.content: We played games and soon became friends.
sentences.english: We played games and soon became friends
sentences.chinese: 我们一起玩游戏，很快就成了朋友。

sentences.content: Later, someone took out his accordion, and soon everyone got together to sing and dance.
sentences.english: Later , someone took out his accordion , and soon everyone got together to sing and dance
sentences.chinese: 后来，有人拿出了他的手风琴，很快大家就聚在一起唱歌跳舞。

sentences.content: We were so happy that we didn’t notice the time.
sentences.english: We were so happy that we didn't notice the time
sentences.chinese: 我们太开心了，以至于都没注意到时间。

sentences.content: It was such a good experience!
sentences.english: It was such a good experience !
sentences.chinese: 这真是一次绝妙的体验！
